svg.title: An explicit rotating Lagrangian translator
svg.desc: Exact coordinates · projection of X(x,s) = (x eⁱˢ, x²/2 − is) in C²

g.text: Exact coordinates · projection of X(x,s) = (x eⁱˢ, x²/2 − is) in C²
The last imaginary coordinate separates successive turns; the surface is embedded.
Only |x| ≤ 2.4 and |s| ≤ 2π are shown. The lifted angle is s − π/2.
